description: Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes cannot be coded together on the same encounter.
Mixed hyperlipidemia and Testicular hypofunction are mutually exclusive per Excludes1.
Routine gynecological exam and cervical cancer screening cannot be billed together.
Cytology symptom and definitive mild cervical dysplasia diagnosis cannot be paired.
Primary essential hypertension and renovascular hypertension cannot be coded together.
Unspecified asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease conflict in primary assignment.
Unspecified acute pharyngitis cannot be paired with streptococcal pharyngitis.
GERD without esophagitis cannot be coded with GERD with esophagitis.
Unspecified low back pain is redundant when specific sciatica is coded.
Unspecified acute sinusitis cannot be paired with acute maxillary sinusitis.
